title: API Settings
description: Configuration file stored in .restless/settings.json. Written by the CLI, read by @restlessai/sdk at startup. Commit it with your code: it is configuration, not a build artifact, and it holds no credentials. Kept in step with the code by tests/settings-schema.test.js.

$schema.description: Path to the JSON schema for validation

apis.description: The APIs in this workspace. One Restless project per entry.

id.description: Unique identifier for this API, stable across machines for syncing

rootDir.description: Relative path to the root directory of this API

projectId.description: The Restless project this API uploads to. Assigned when the project is registered; the dashboard knows it as metricsId.

oasFile.description: Relative path to this API's OpenAPI spec. Either a file we generated under .restless/, or one you maintain elsewhere that we only ever read.

oasSource.description: How the spec got here. `npx restless update` reads this to decide what refreshing means: re-fetch a URL, re-read a file you maintain, re-run a framework generator, or re-scan the routes.

kind.description: ai: our model read the routes. native: the framework's own generator. found: already in the repo, we never write it. file: you pointed us at a path. url: fetched from a URL. describe: located from a plain-English description. combined: several specs you maintain, combined into .restless/openapi.json. agent: written by a coding agent via `npx restless register`.

framework.description: kind=native: which framework emitted the spec

path.description: kind=found: where the spec already lived in the repo

input.description: kind=file: the path you gave us

url.description: kind=url: the URL to re-fetch from

summary.description: kind=describe: what was actually done to find the spec, not the instruction you typed

paths.description: kind=combined: the specs that were combined, in order. We only ever read these.

baseUrl.description: Production base URL for this API. Null when no public URL was confirmed.

internal.description: Internal/admin API rather than customer-facing. Inferred during setup; `npx restless update` flips it.

requestIdPrefix.description: Decorative prefix on this API's request IDs (e.g. TST-9f18a0e2-...). 1-7 uppercase letters or digits.

testCurl.description: A safe GET request against this API, chosen during setup so the test step doesn't need an AI pass to find one.

redact.description: Custom credential fields to strip from captured logs, merged with the SDK's built-in defaults at startup.

oasHash.description: sha256 of the spec's exact bytes as last pushed to the dashboard. Lets `npx restless update` tell you a spec you maintain yourself has changed since then - those are the only kinds where nothing is fetched, so there is otherwise no baseline to compare against.

oasOperationCount.description: Operations in the spec as last pushed. Paired with oasHash because a hash says only that something changed; this says how much.

lastSyncedAt.description: ISO 8601 timestamp of the last time the CLI wrote this entry
